text:
Arlo Park: hey folks! first day at Redwood 🎉 brought my (extremely precious) sourdough starter and an old espresso tamper. hi!!
Juno (People Ops): welcome @Arlo :wave: so glad you're here. curious: coffee, tea, or matcha? also are you in office or remote today?
Arlo Park: thanks!! coffee > tea. i'm hybrid — in SF office today, desk near window on 3rd floor. quick question: is there a communal fridge label protocol? don't want to create a starter incident. 
Mira Patel: hi Arlo — welcome! we do fridge labels, facilities prefers this format: `@name — item — date`. 
Sam (Facilities): adding: please put sourdough jars on the top shelf and label with `starter — Arlo — 03/04` so we don't accidentally toss. if it's in a mason jar, put a lid but not airtight.
Arlo Park: ohhh good to know, will do. also full disclosure: i will attempt latte art and probably fail gloriously the first 3 tries ☕️😅
Talia: latte-art club meeting? count me in. also friday lunch? we do a new-hires micro-potluck sometimes — bring something tiny if you want.
Arlo Park: micro-potluck yes please. i can bring sourdough crumpets (is that a thing?) and maybe garlic butter.
Juno (People Ops): love it. i'll add you to the Friday lunch thread and schedule a 10-min intro with People Ops so we can run through benefits and swag pickup.
onboarding-bot: Hey @Arlo — complete your I-9 and photo ID upload here: https://redwood.onboard/2210001112. You're 2/5 steps done.
Mira Patel: fyi our sticker rack is by the kitchen sink — take as many bot stickers as you want.
Sam (Facilities): PS — if you want a small desk plant we have a 'plant adoption' box. pick one and write your name on the card.
Talia: welcome again, Arlo. can't wait to hear the toast vs coffee experiments. :thumbsup:
Arlo Park: thanks everyone!! see you at lunch and will definitely label the jar like a responsible sourdough citizen 🫶
